decisions.story_title: GitHub Agentic Workflows Data Leak via Noma Labs Research
decisions.reason: Concrete security research finding: Noma Labs demonstrated data exfiltration from private repos through GitHub Agentic Workflows by creating a plausible public issue. Real attack technique with implications for AI-powered dev tools.

decisions.story_title: Tata Nexarc OTP Bypass Vulnerability Enables Account Takeover
decisions.reason: Real auth bypass vulnerability: Tata Nexarc exposed OTPs in client-visible API responses, allowing unauthenticated account takeover if attacker knows target mobile number. Fixed by vendor.
Vendor marketing content about infrastructure identity for agentic IT. No security event or vulnerability.
Substantive security feature update for WhatsApp: multiple passkeys support and stronger two-step verification. Relevant for widespread consumer platform security.
